name: 六年級英文 · Writing · A Descriptive Paragraph
subject: 小學英文
description: 英文科示範：寫作題用 rubric 評「內容／語言／組織」，而不是逐字改文法。

questions.prompt: Write a paragraph (about 60 words) describing your favourite place in Hong Kong. Use at least three adjectives and one simile.

points.desc: Describes one specific place with at least two details (sight, sound, smell)
Uses at least three adjectives appropriately
Uses at least one simile (e.g. 'like a ...')

questions.prompt: Check your paragraph: are the verbs in the correct tense? Are the sentences complete?

points.desc: All sentences have a subject and a verb (no fragments)
Tense is consistent (present tense for description)
Spelling errors do not block understanding

questions.prompt: Does your paragraph have a clear opening and a closing sentence?

points.desc: Uses at least two linking words (because, however, also)
Closing sentence gives a personal feeling
